text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day before the Yayoi Sho and
Manhattan
Cafe and Agnes Tachyon are
in their shared
classroom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, my cryotherapy strategy is set
in place.
Just what I need to handle an
ever faster track!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Cafe? Is that fire in your
eyes your
way of warming up for
tomorrow's race? Or
perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Why? Why did you tell me that you're
running in
the Yayoi Sho?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It isn't like you to share unnecessary
information.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh. "Unnecessary," you say?
What I
consider necessary is determined
by me, not you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow marks the Yayoi Sho, a race
more
significant than even the Satsuki
Sho. Titles like
G1 and G2 are nothing
more than
externally-assigned signifiers.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Some things can mean more to the
individual than
their standardized
classifications suggest!
Important
judgments must be made from time to

time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, I mean to say it's an
important race to
me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And I'm glad that you made it, you
know. You
came along sooner than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I want you to show me who
you are.
Show me your present, and your
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Yayoi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I talked with Tachyon yesterday.
About a lot of
things...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing. She speaks in terms that
make sense
only to her...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think it might be best to put it to one
side for
now. It's more important that I...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'll find out in today's race if
chasing
Tachyon is the fastest way to get
closer to my
friend...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'll chase her down. And I'll
use all the
strength I can muster. ...So
watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be the worry showing on her
face, but
Manhattan Cafe looks quite
worn out. It's clear
how serious she is.
